name: Zdeněk Zeman
scopeNote: Counted spells: Foggia 1989-94, Lazio 1994-Jan 1997, Roma 1997-99, Pescara 2011-12. Exact appointment and departure days were not found in the mined pages; start/end dates are approximations (summer 1989, June 2011, June 2012) and partial. Style is called Zemanlandia (Foggia dei Miracoli): 4-3-3 with zonal marking, high line, offside trap, pressing, sweeper-keeper and full-backs/forwards overloading; Pescara described as 'anarchy'. Popular label 'ultra-offensive' omits that sources say he drilled zone defending ('applies defence by attacking'). Partial dates in spellsExcluded (years/months) are approximate, taken from digests, not verified by day. Calcio e Finanza style facts are unverified (2014 article about Cagliari, outside counted spells; same style described in counted spells by other sources). Excluded: Licata, Parma, Messina, Fenerbahce, Napoli, Salernitana, Avellino, Lecce, Roma 2012-13, Cagliari, Lugano, Pescara 2017-18/2023-24, Foggia 2021-22 (no title or recognised style coverage, failures or short stints).
openQuestions: Exact dates not verified in digest: Foggia start (summer 1989), Lazio start (1994) and sacking (January 1997, after loss to Bologna), Roma 1997-99 (end summer 1999), Pescara start (June 2011) and end; profilePeriod uses approximations.
Licata (1983-86, promotion to C1) and Roma 2012-13 considered but excluded; Roma 2012-13 quotes (Blitz 2013) kept only in statedView.
Zeman's Lazio shape: Lazio Stories says he changed from 4-3-3 once at Lazio; not detailed.
Doping accusations of 1998 (Roma) are context, not tactics; Calcio e Finanza dates them to 'Lecce 1998', which conflicts with other sources (Roma).
Two TFT pieces: 2018 text found in a 2016 version too; Il Fatto Quotidiano URL mined returned unrelated content and was discarded.
Primary dated sources for statedView are mostly secondary quotations; the 2012 Blizzard interview and La bellezza non ha prezzo (2022) were not mined.

sources.title: Zemanlandia: the truth behind the cult (These Football Times)
sources.evidence: His refined technique and ball-playing capabilities would not go unrecognised by the Czech coach, who threw the youngster in at the deep end without hesitation. By 19, Nesta was a regular in Lazio’s starting line-up.

sources.title: Zemanlandia: the truth behind the cult (These Football Times)
sources.evidence: Totti had been a frequent starter for three seasons by the time he came under Zeman’s influence, but had yet to hit double figures. He scored 14 goals in 1997/98, 16 in 1998/99, and took both the number 10 shirt and the club captaincy in the process.

sources.title: The birth of Zemanlandia (These Football Times)
sources.evidence: A devotee of the 4-3-3 system with zonal marking and pressing all over the pitch, having players whose stamina could keep them running for the ninety minutes and beyond was essential.

sources.title: The birth of Zemanlandia (These Football Times)
sources.evidence: The way that they hounded opponents for the ball was relentless, pioneering a way of playing that was a couple of decades ahead of its time.

sources.title: The birth of Zemanlandia (These Football Times)
sources.evidence: often shocking teams with the ferocity and intensity of their pressing.

sources.title: The birth of Zemanlandia (These Football Times)
sources.evidence: Given the aggressive pressing and high defensive line that Zeman demanded, he needed a goalkeeper who wasn’t simply a good shot-stopper but also had the speed and presence of mind to sweep up behind his defenders.

sources.title: The birth of Zemanlandia (These Football Times)
sources.evidence: Mancini could perform his role to perfection, making him one of the first sweeper-keepers; an oddity in football of that era but ultimately a pioneer of a new way of playing that role.

sources.title: The birth of Zemanlandia (These Football Times)
sources.evidence: Foggia were expected to play once they won the Serie B in 1991. After all they were a small club managed by an unknown and with a squad full of inexperienced players, none of whom was even a remotely familiar name. But instead of doing what many others had done before them and cowered when put in front of the mighty elite of Italian football, Foggia went on the attack

sources.title: The birth of Zemanlandia (These Football Times)
sources.evidence: As before, Foggia went for quality at a reduced price and, at Zeman’s prompting, brought in three players from Eastern Europe: Igor Shalimov, Igor Kolyvanov and Dan Petrescu.

sources.title: The birth of Zemanlandia (These Football Times)
sources.evidence: Another of Zeman’s favoured training methods was having players run up and down the terracing of the Pino Zaccheria stadium. (...) All of this physical work was necessary for Zeman’s systems to work.

sources.title: Tactics: Pure Attacking Football in Pescara (Forza Italian Football)
sources.evidence: When you watch Pescara play it’s easy to describe their setup as a relatively conventional 4-3-3 with fluid movement from back to front. (...) if I was forced to describe this sytem in a word that word would be anarchy.

sources.title: Tactics: Pure Attacking Football in Pescara (Forza Italian Football)
sources.evidence: Pescara ignore any sense of balance as their players pour forwards in waves creating overloads all the way across the pitch but leaving the team exposed defensively.

sources.title: Tactics: Pure Attacking Football in Pescara (Forza Italian Football)
sources.evidence: Once more Zdenek Zeman has built a side based around absolute attacking football with little apparent consideration to the defensive phase of play.

sources.title: Tactics: Pure Attacking Football in Pescara (Forza Italian Football)
sources.evidence: Zdenek Zeman has also come to believe wholeheartedly in the vibrancy of youth. Loan signings such as Ciro Immobile, from Juventus, and Lorenzo Insigne, from Napoli, have shown that they have real ability to go alongside their apparent potential. It’s a homegrown player that perhaps provides the key to the side though with 19 year old playmaker Marco Verratti dictating the waves of attacking pressure

sources.title: Tactics: Pure Attacking Football in Pescara (Forza Italian Football)
sources.evidence: players being encouraged to be expressive and to attempt things that more tactically disciplined coaches would reproach them for.

sources.title: Legend of Calcio: Zdenek Zeman (Forza Italian Football)
sources.evidence: He introduced the 4-3-3 to Serie A and whilst most teams preferred to pack their midfield the Foggia coach preferred to pack his attack.

sources.title: Legend of Calcio: Zdenek Zeman (Forza Italian Football)
sources.evidence: they will be expected to play as high up the pitch as possible, relying on the offside trap, an extreme form of zonal marking and the goalkeeper to deal with any incursions that they fail to repel.

sources.title: Legend of Calcio: Zdenek Zeman (Forza Italian Football)
sources.evidence: When out of possession, the Czech asks the nearest players to crowd out the opposition in an attempt to strangle the space around him so that he is more likely to lose the ball.

sources.title: Legend of Calcio: Zdenek Zeman (Forza Italian Football)
sources.evidence: the most important elements of his ‘defence’ are the full backs and they are tasked with tirelessly running the flanks and provide support not only to the midfield but to the trident attack.

sources.title: Legend of Calcio: Zdenek Zeman (Forza Italian Football)
sources.evidence: He expects as many players as possible to fill the final third of the pitch in order to maximise the chances his team create by outnumbering their opponent.

sources.title: Manager Series: Zdenek Zeman (Lazio Stories)

sources.title: Manager Series: Zdenek Zeman (Lazio Stories)
sources.evidence: He chose players that could thrive in his 4-3-3 formation. They did not necessarily need to have a footballing pedigree but it was important they could be functional to his tactical vision.

sources.title: Manager Series: Zdenek Zeman (Lazio Stories)
sources.evidence: One thing however is training a bunch of players who were not that famous and another is telling experienced pros that how they had trained for years in pre-season was completely wrong. Zeman was bound to have problems in trying to change Lazio’s mentality.

sources.title: Manager Series: Zdenek Zeman (Lazio Stories)
